en.headline: Hong Kong records net loss of 40 kindergartens amid falling births
en.dek: The Education Bureau’s latest profiles show 930 kindergartens operating, a record annual net decrease of 40 as the student population shrinks and first-time mothers grow older.
body: The Education Bureau released the latest online profiles of local kindergartens and childcare centres on Thursday, listing about 930 institutions currently operating in Hong Kong.

According to the South China Morning Post’s analysis of the figures, the number is down from roughly 970 in the previous school year, marking a net loss of 40 kindergartens — the highest on record. Each of the previous four academic years saw a net decrease of about 20.

The decline comes as Hong Kong’s birth rate continues to fall and the median age of women giving birth to their first child has reached a new high. The bureau has previously noted that kindergarten numbers adjust naturally with the student population and has encouraged operators to consolidate resources or relocate from ageing districts.

zh.headline: 本港幼稚園按年淨減40間 創紀錄跌幅
zh.dek: 教育局最新概覽顯示全港約有930間幼稚園運作，按年淨減40間，為歷來最高，學生人口持續萎縮。
body: 教育局周四公布最新幼稚園及幼兒中心概覽，列出全港約930間現正運作的幼稚園。
據《南華早報》分析有關數字，數目較上學年約970間減少，淨減40間，是歷來最高。過去四個學年每年淨減約20間。
跌幅源於本港出生率持續下跌，以及首次生育婦女的中位年齡創新高。教育局早前指出，隨學生人口下降，幼稚園數目會自然調整，並鼓勵辦學團體整合資源或從人口老化地區搬遷。
